requirements.text: Enable patients to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online
Reduce the burden on reception staff during peak hours
Provide secure access to test results once reviewed by a clinician
Ensure compliance with GDPR and maintain the security of patient data
Create a user-friendly interface that accommodates elderly patients and those who may not be tech-savvy
Appointment booking interface must display available time slots for GP and nurse appointments
Allow patients to cancel or reschedule appointments directly through the portal
Enable GPs and nurses to set their availability within the appointment booking system
Implement a mechanism for patients to flag urgent symptoms for same-day or emergency appointments
Create a user-friendly interface for repeat prescription requests
Allow patients to see a list of current prescriptions and select medications to reorder
Include a confirmation step for patients to review their prescription selections before submission
Enable patients to add notes or specify changes regarding their medications
Send automatic confirmation notifications to patients upon submission of prescription requests
Create a system for clinicians to review and approve prescription requests
Notify patients when their prescription is ready for collection or sent to their pharmacy
Implement a secure identity verification process for accessing test results
Present test results in an easy-to-understand format, including a summary and normal ranges
Allow patients to message their clinician directly through the portal regarding test results
Prevent patients from accessing test results before clinician review
Integrate the portal seamlessly with existing practice management software
Maintain budget constraints for development, implementation, and maintenance of the portal
Adhere to accessibility guidelines to ensure usability for all patients
Minimize the learning curve for reception staff with a user-friendly system
